title: Comrades Start Information — 2026 Start Map diagram
claims: The Start Information page provides a Start Map diagram for the 2026 Up Run start village, separate from the Static route map PDF that shows the full 2026 route.
Neither the Start Map nor the Static route map is a 2027 Down Run document; the 2027 route map, GPX and redistributable trajectory licence remain unpublished at the check date.
